case_name: Haryana State Cooperative Labour and Construction Federation Limited v Unique Cooperative Labour and Construction Cooperative Society Limited and others
petitioner: Haryana State Cooperative Labour and Construction Federation Limited
respondent: Unique Cooperative Labour and Construction Cooperative Society Limited
facts: The Haryana State Cooperative Labour and Construction Federation Limited was engaged in the execution of Government works.
In 1981, the Haryana Federation was assigned the work of construction of low income group houses (numbering 58, 76 and 82), in Sector 15, Panchkula, Haryana, by the Haryana Housing Board.
The Haryana Federation entered into three separate construction contracts with respondent no.1 - Unique Cooperative Labour and Construction Cooperative Society Ltd., on 20.7.1981.
By a different contractual agreement dated 2.11.1981, the Haryana Federation also allotted construction work of a sports complex located at Murthal, Haryana, to the Construction Society.
The Haryana Federation referred three disputes against the work awarding agency - the Haryana Housing Board, to the Registrar, Cooperative Societies, Haryana.
issues: Whether the Haryana Federation's appeal was maintainable before the Registrar, Cooperative Societies, Haryana?
Whether the Haryana Federation's revision petition was maintainable before the Principal Secretary, Department of Cooperation, Government of Haryana?
Whether the High Court's order dismissing Writ Petition no.20055 of 2011 was correct?
petitioner_arguments: The Haryana Federation argued that its appeal was maintainable before the Registrar, Cooperative Societies, Haryana.
The Haryana Federation argued that its revision petition was maintainable before the Principal Secretary, Department of Cooperation, Government of Haryana.
The Haryana Federation argued that the High Court's order dismissing Writ Petition no.20055 of 2011 was incorrect.
respondent_arguments: The respondent argued that the Haryana Federation's appeal was not maintainable before the Registrar, Cooperative Societies, Haryana.
The respondent argued that the Haryana Federation's revision petition was not maintainable before the Principal Secretary, Department of Cooperation, Government of Haryana.
The respondent argued that the High Court's order dismissing Writ Petition no.20055 of 2011 was correct.
court_reasoning: The court held that the Haryana Federation's appeal was not maintainable before the Registrar, Cooperative Societies, Haryana.
The court held that the Haryana Federation's revision petition was not maintainable before the Principal Secretary, Department of Cooperation, Government of Haryana.
The court held that the High Court's order dismissing Writ Petition no.20055 of 2011 was correct.
holding: The court dismissed the Haryana Federation's appeal and revision petition.
The court upheld the High Court's order dismissing Writ Petition no.20055 of 2011.
